extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as 0cc0de327cc0967d325949c66d91824a2738577fcec2e28b0b72b102fac2c252; the supplied identity is LCSC C18199163, MPN ES3JB, manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The datasheet is a family sheet for ES3AB through ES3JB. The exact ES3JB column and all three pages were examined; the visible manufacturer is Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd.

Fig. 3 contains three grouped forward-voltage curves. The dotted ES3JB curve was digitized at visible voltage positions from 1.1 V through 1.8 V at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle; no intermediate points were synthesized or interpolated.

Fig. 4 contains typical reverse-characteristics curves at Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 125 degC. The plotted reverse current is represented as positive magnitude in amperes; points were digitized at 0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%, and 120% of rated peak reverse voltage with no intermediate points synthesized or interpolated.

The ES3JB electrical-characteristics rows give maximum VF = 1.7 V at IF = 3.0 A, maximum Trr = 35 ns at IF = 0.5 A, IR = 1.0 A, and Irr = 0.25 A, maximum IR1 = 2.0 uA at VR = VDC = 600 V and Ta = 25 degC, separate maximum IR2 = 200 uA at Ta = 125 degC, and typical CJ = 65 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz. SI conversions are used in specs: 2 uA = 2e-6 A, 65 pF = 6.5e-11 F, and 35 ns = 3.5e-8 s.

Absolute maximum ratings for ES3JB include VRRM = 600 V, VRMS = 420 V, VDC = 600 V, IF(AV) = 3.0 A at 60 Hz sinewave with resistance load, IFSM = 100 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, and Tj/Tstg = -55 to +150 degC. These ratings are limits and are not treated as breakdown data.
The supplied datasheet publishes no breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification; VRRM and VDC ratings are blocking ratings, not measured breakdown data.
